text:
Nadia: Morning micro-drama: my desk succulent and Ben's office cactus got into a sunlight standoff and someone left a tiny flag between them. Did we just invent plant nationalism? :raised_hands:
Ben: It was a diplomatic mission. The flag was a post-it that said 'Neutral Ground' with a doodle. I demand recognition for the Sovereign Cactus.
Rina: This is peak Redwood culture. Also who put a paper umbrella in the succulent? I laughed for 5 minutes.
Seth: Can we have a small ceremony? I can DJ ambient nature sounds.
Nadia: Proposal: "Potted Peace Pact" every Friday 3pm. Short vows, watered plants, cookies. /poll "Yes, weekly pact" "Monthly ceremony" "No ceremonies, just peace"
Facilities Bot: New poll created: "Potted Peace Pact" 4dc vote with :one: :two: :three: (ends in 8h)
Ben: :one: obviously. Also we need an official miniature treaty document.
Rina: :two: I like monthly better so we don't overwhelm the plants.
Seth: :three: Keep it chill. I'll supply cookies either way.
Nadia: Also, can Facilities confirm that plant placement on the east ledge is allowed? I don't want to be fined under the "No Personal Flora" rule. @Facilities Bot
Facilities Bot: Facilities ticket #FAC-900 opened: "Plant placement & Potted Peace Pact event". Response ETA 2 business days.
Ben: If Facilities says no, we start a petition with signatures and tiny leaf stickers.
Rina: Adding a GIF for morale: https://giphy.com/gifs/plant-friendship-3oEduSbSGpGaRX2Vri :heart:
Nadia: Results so far: :one: 2, :two: 1, :three: 0. Looks like weekly is winning.
Seth: I will draft a one-paragraph oath: "We the people of Redwood hereby pledge to water, not crowd, and respect the sunlight of all potted citizens."
Ben: Signing as Ambassador of Cactus. Also making a tiny flag prototype.
Facilities Bot: Poll closed. Final results: :one: 3, :two: 1, :three: 0. Outcome: Weekly pact approved. Facilities response pending.
Nadia: Ceremony scheduled next Friday 3pm. Dress code: plant-friendly (no heavy colognes). Meeting adjourned. :seedling:
